cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your plate's back in the cupboard, ready for Sunday lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That one's got flowers. Ours were plain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll take that one. The potatoes will cover the flowers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not hiding it under potatoes. I want six matching plates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get five more before lunch. Keep the plain ones for spares; there's no need to count those today.

mechanism: A hides replacing a damaged or lost plate by correcting B table-setting expectations and expanding the replacement into a complete professionally matched service.
confusable: D12 asks someone to give up a valued possession; this A secretly restores an object or set without explaining what happened to the original.
comparison: Umbrella alternative cleans revealing debris; plate alternative makes the discrepant replacement become the new matching standard.
seedUse: Floral replacement, plain plates and matching six derive from D37-b; S03 supplies service consistency and controlled cupboard placement as the concealment method.
